finding: A passing allowed pytest file can rewrite its own bytes; executor committed an untested candidate and returned REVIEW_REQUESTED.
required_repair: Bind tests to exact immutable candidate bytes or tree and refuse check mutation before returning a review request.
other_findings: Proposal test code has host filesystem access; production remains blocked without a real execution sandbox and credential boundary.
Empty hook directory is writable by test code, Git commands inherit full environment and config, and Git subprocesses have no timeout.
Fixed pytest argv does not constrain pytest repository config or module shadowing.
Mandatory detached Aura review gate remains red because trust is unprovisioned.
